profile.title: Leader Profile
profile.lead: A Big Five personality profile for your own development. You see it first, and nobody else sees it unless you share it.
profile.fullFacts: 120 questions · about 20 minutes · five domains and 30 facets
profile.measuresLead: The Leader Profile follows the Big Five, which describes personality in five broad domains. The full test splits each domain into {perDomain} facets.
profile.quickNames: The quick test measures the five domains only, under the {quick}'s own names: {names}.
profile.questionsLead: Each question is a short statement. You say how accurately it describes you as you are now, not as you wish to be.
profile.exampleLabel: Example: the first statement of the {test}
profile.questionsPer: The quick test asks {quickPer} statements for each domain. The full test asks {fullPer} for each facet.
profile.questionsReversed: Some statements count the other way, as the published key sets: agreeing with them lowers the trait. In the full test, {reversed} of the {total} do.
profile.questionsWording: The statements are the source's, word for word, so they keep its American spelling and short fragments.
profile.questionsDevice: Your answers stay on this device until you finish. Only the result is kept, and only if you keep it.
profile.resultBands: Each trait is placed lower, middle or higher on the answer scale. An average answer below {lower} is lower, above {higher} is higher, and the rest is middle.

common.sourcesNote: Each source was checked on {date}. This article is general information about leadership teams, not advice on a particular team.

articles.title: Articles on leadership team effectiveness
articles.description: Research-based articles for people who lead a leadership team: purpose, size, meetings, trust, conflict and how to assess a team. Every claim sourced.
articles.lead: What the research says about making a leadership team work, written for the person who leads one. Each article answers one question first, then shows its sources.

start.title: Where to start
start.text: What makes a leadership team effective, and how to see where yours stands.

conditions.title: Purpose, tasks and membership
conditions.text: The conditions that come first: why the team exists, which work needs all of it, and who belongs in it.

meetings.title: Meetings and decisions
meetings.text: Where a leadership team does most of its work together, and how to make that time count.

dynamics.title: How the team works together
dynamics.text: Psychological safety, trust and conflict: the states that make it possible to speak up and decide well.

templates.title: Free templates and a guide for leadership teams
templates.description: Free resources for leadership teams: a team charter, a meeting agenda with item types and outcomes, and a guide to how leadership teams work.
templates.h1: Free templates and a guide for leadership teams
templates.lead: A charter the team writes together, an agenda that says what every item is for, and a guide that brings the articles together. Each is free for an e-mail address.

guide.title: How leadership teams really work
guide.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# chapter} other {# chapters}} on purpose, membership, meetings, trust and conflict, each with the research it rests on.
guide.about1: This guide brings together the articles published at {site}. Each chapter answers one question a leadership team asks.
guide.about2: Every chapter opens with its answer and the points to take away. Its figures draw the argument, and its sources are listed at the end.
guide.about3: The sources were checked on {date}. The articles online are kept up to date, so read them there for the latest version.
guide.nextTemplates: Free templates for a team charter and a meeting agenda are at {site}/templates.
guide.nextScan: To see how your own team works, the Leadership Team Scan at {site} takes about three minutes and needs no account.

conditions.title: Conditions · {count} scales
conditions.text: How the team is set up: purpose, tasks, people and support.

processes.title: Processes · {count} scales
processes.text: How the team works, in and between meetings.

states.title: States · {count} scales
states.text: How it feels to be part of the team.

outcomes.title: Outcomes · {count}
outcomes.text: What the team achieves together. Members rate these themselves.

figures.exampleNote: An example to show the idea, not data from a real team.

shots.note: A fictional group: every name and answer is invented.

assess.title: Assess
assess.invited: {count, plural, one {# person asked} other {# people asked}}
assess.notAsked: You joined after this round opened, so you answer the next one.
assess.extended: Fewer than {k} had answered by the closing date, so it was extended once, by 7 days.
assess.noResult: Fewer than {k} answered, so no result was made and the answers were deleted.
assess.released: The result was computed once, when the round closed.
assess.emptyLeader: No rounds yet. When you open the Full diagnostic, everyone in the group is asked at once.
assess.emptyMember: No rounds yet. Your team leader opens the Full diagnostic, and everyone in the group is asked at once.
assess.openBody: {questions} questions on how the group works, about 10 minutes each. Every current member is asked: {members, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}. It stays open for {days} days.
assess.openRule: Results open to everyone when it closes, if at least {k} have answered. Until then everyone sees a count, never a score.
assess.openAsk: Open it now for all {members} members?
assess.openAskBody: Everyone is asked at once. A round cannot be cancelled, and the next one can open when it closes.
assess.tooFew: A round needs at least {k} members, so no answer can point to a person. The group has {members}.
assess.oneAtATime: One round at a time: the next one can open when this one closes.
assess.openRefusedOpen: A round is already open. The next one can open when it closes.
assess.openRefusedPlan: Opening a round needs the Team plan, and a group that is not read-only.
assess.openRefusedLeader: Only the team leader opens a round.
assess.openFailed: The round could not be opened. Try again in a few minutes.
assess.howAsked: Everyone in the group when it opens is asked. Someone who joins later answers the next round.
assess.howStored: Answers are stored with a random ID, never with a name. Everyone sees how many have answered, never who.
assess.howOpens: It closes on its date, or when everyone has answered. Results open to all members then, if at least {k} have answered.
assess.missed: Missed: fewer than {k} answered, so no result was made and the answers were deleted.

round.heading: Full diagnostic
round.purpose: How your group works today, scale by scale. Together, your answers show the group where it stands and what to work on.
round.lead: {count} statements, one per screen, in mixed order. It takes about 10 minutes.
round.storedNoName: They are stored with a random ID, never with your name.
round.storedCount: The group sees how many have answered, never who.
round.storedOpens: Results open to everyone when the round closes on {date}, if at least {k} have answered.
round.storedDevice: Your progress is saved on this device until you submit.
round.onDevice: Saved on this device until you submit.
round.gaps: {count, plural, one {# question has no answer yet. Every question needs one.} other {# questions have no answer yet. Every question needs one.}}
round.submitBody: Your answers are stored with a random ID, never with your name. The group sees how many have answered, never who.
round.failed: Your answers could not be sent. Try again in a few minutes.
round.invalid: Your answers did not match this round's questions. Please answer again.
round.doneBody: Nobody can see who answered what. Results open to the whole group when the round closes.
round.answeredBody: Your answers are in. Results open to the whole group when the round closes.
round.closedBody: Answers are no longer taken. Answers after the close are not added.
round.notInvitedTitle: You are not asked in this round
round.notInvitedBody: Everyone in the group when a round opens is asked. You answer the next one.
round.pulsePurpose: A short check on your focus areas and working agreements between diagnostics.
round.pulseLead: {count, plural, one {# statement, in mixed order. It takes a minute.} other {# statements, one per screen, in mixed order. It takes a minute or two.}}

results.title: Results
results.summary: Opened {opened} · {answered} of {total} answered. Counts only, never names.
results.label: Research-based, not yet validated · scale 1–5
results.layerMeta_outcomes: What the group achieves together. Self-rated.
results.layerMeta_conditions: How the group is set up: purpose, tasks, people and support.
results.layerMeta_processes: How the group works, in and between meetings.
results.layerMeta_states: How it feels to be part of the group.
results.changeRule: Change since round {number} shows only at {margin} points or more, and only where the questions were the same.
results.changeFirst: This is the first round with a result, so no change shows.
results.footnote: Standing labels are words, not colours. Low agreement always reads Views differ.
results.emptyOpen: Round {number} is open: {answered} of {total} answered. Results open to everyone when it closes, if at least {k} have answered.
results.emptyClosed: Round {number} closed with fewer than {k} answers, so it has no result.
results.emptyNone: Results open to everyone when a round of the Full diagnostic closes with enough answers.
results.readFailed: The results could not be read. Try again in a few minutes.
results.basedOn: Based on {n} answers. Counts only, never names.
results.guide_views_differ: Your views differ on {scale}. Talk about what each of you sees before you decide what to change.
results.guide_fact: {scale} describes how the group is set up. It has no target, so read it as a fact about the group.
results.guide_read_with: Read {scale} together with relationship conflict. The two say more side by side than either does alone.
results.guide_priority_direct: Make {scale} a priority. The research link between this scale and team results is strong.
results.guide_priority_likely: Working on {scale} is likely to help. The research link between this scale and team results is moderate.
results.guide_describe: {scale} reads {level}. The research points both ways, so this carries no flag.
results.guide_watch: {scale} is neither a priority nor a strength. Keep an eye on it in the next round.
results.guide_strength: {scale} is a strength. Keep doing what makes it work.
results.guide_outcome: {scale} is an outcome the group rates itself. The scales are what the group can work on to change it.
results.why_strong: Meta-analyses show a consistent link between this scale and team results.
results.why_moderate: Studies show a link to team results, but it is smaller or less consistent.
results.why_mixed: Findings point both ways, so the scale is shown as a fact without a target.
results.why_not_rated: The evidence has not been rated yet. It is treated as moderate until reviewed.
results.why_self_rated: An outcome the group rates itself. Outcomes carry no evidence rating.
results.itemsLead: Each question's mean across the group's answers, to one decimal.

plan.title: Plan
plan.closeBody: Its actions stay, and a place opens for another scale. A closed focus area stays closed.
plan.openNoRound: Focus areas come from the results. Once a round of the Full diagnostic is released, choose up to {max} scales here.
plan.openChoose: Choose a scale below, or from its page in the results.
plan.openMember: The team leader records the scales the group chooses.
plan.fullNote: All {max} places are taken. Close a focus area to choose another scale.
plan.meetingActionsFrom: Saved in the live meeting, each with an owner and a due date.
plan.full: At most {max} focus areas can be active. Close one first.
plan.already: That scale is already a focus area.
plan.unavailable: The plan cannot change now. The group is read-only or not on the Team plan.
plan.noOwner: Pick an owner. An action without an owner cannot be saved.
plan.notOwner: Only the action's owner or the team leader can change it.
plan.invalid: That could not be saved. Check the title and the date.
plan.writeFailed: That did not save. Try again.
plan.ruleFocus: At most {max} focus areas are active at once. A new one needs one to close first.
plan.ruleOwner: Every action has an owner and a due date. An action without an owner cannot be saved.
plan.ruleAgenda: Each open action appears on the next agenda.
plan.ruleWho: The team leader records the scales the group chooses. Any member can add an action.
plan.ruleNoTarget: No target is set on a survey score.
plan.readOnly: The group is read-only, so the plan cannot change.
plan.isFocus: This scale is one of the group's focus areas.
plan.fullForScale: All {max} focus areas are taken. Close one on the Plan page to choose this scale.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.noneLeader: Plan the next meeting. Its agenda starts with the closing item, and every member can propose items.
meetings.noneMember: Your team leader plans the meetings. You can propose items once one is planned.
meetings.lengthRange: A meeting lasts from 15 to 480 minutes.
meetings.startRefused: The meeting cannot start: another meeting of the group is live.
meetings.cancelAsk: Cancel {title}? Its agenda stays, and it no longer counts as planned.
meetings.timeMeter: Planned time against the meeting length
meetings.unmatched: {count, plural, =0 {Every item matches a team task.} one {# item matches no team task.} other {# items match no team task.}}
meetings.checkOff: Off: no team tasks are in force.
meetings.checkOffLeader: No team tasks are in force, so no item can be checked against them.
meetings.checkOffMember: No team tasks are in force yet. Your team leader defines them in the charter.
meetings.defineTasks: Define the team tasks in the charter
meetings.readyRule: Ready needs a type, a desired outcome, an owner and a time box.
meetings.proposeNote: Any member can propose an item. Its type, outcome, owner and time box can wait, but it is not ready without them.
meetings.outcomeHint: What the group should have when the item is done.
meetings.minutesRange: A time box is from 1 to 240 minutes.
meetings.unmatchedItem: {title} matches no team task. It stays if the team leader confirms it.
meetings.openActionsNote: Every open action of the group appears on the next agenda.
meetings.notNext: Open actions appear on the next meeting's agenda.
meetings.unavailable: The agenda cannot change now. The group is read-only or not on the Team plan.
meetings.invalid: That could not be saved. Check the fields.
meetings.noOwner: The owner must be a member of the group.
meetings.noTask: That team task is not in the charter in force.
meetings.full: The agenda holds no more items.
meetings.notAllowed: Only its proposer, its owner or the team leader can change this.
meetings.writeFailed: That did not save. Try again.

live.title: Live meeting
live.lost: The connection dropped. The page is read-only until it reconnects.
live.offBody: Live sync is off. Changes save, and others see them when they reload the page.
live.allClosedLeader: End the meeting to see its summary.
live.allClosedMember: The team leader ends the meeting.
live.noActions: No actions for this item yet.
live.commentsNote: Sent without a name. Everyone sees the comment, never who sent it.
live.comment_purpose: What are we trying to achieve?
live.commentsClosed: Process comments open when {k} or more are online. {count} online now.
live.tooFew: Fewer than {k} are online, so a comment could show who sent it. It was not sent.
live.endBody: Items not closed stay as they are. Items carried over go to the next planned meeting, and the process comments are deleted.
live.summaryLead: {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}, {decisions, plural, one {# decision} other {# decisions}} and {actions, plural, one {# new action} other {# new actions}}.
live.noOwner: Pick an owner. An action without an owner cannot be saved.
live.unavailable: The meeting cannot change now. The group is read-only or not on the Team plan.
live.full: There is no room for more.
live.notLeader: Only the team leader runs the meeting.
live.writeFailed: That did not save. Try again.
live.rateLimited: Too many changes came at once, so the last one was dropped. The meeting has been read again.

notFound.lead: The address may be from an earlier site at this domain, or it may have changed. These pages are a good place to start.

pulses.title: Pulses
pulses.runningNext: Every {weeks} weeks, open for {days} days. The next pulse opens on {date}.
pulses.stopped: Pulses are not running. A pulse is a short check on your focus areas and working agreements, at most 10 questions.
pulses.tooFew: Pulses need at least {k} members, so no answer can point to a person. The group has {members}.
pulses.refusedOpen: One round at a time: pulses can start when the open round closes.
pulses.refusedPlan: Pulses need the Team plan, and a group that is not read-only.
pulses.refusedLeader: Only the team leader sets the pulse rhythm.
pulses.refusedInvalid: Choose a rhythm and a window from the lists. A pulse closes before the next one opens.
pulses.failed: The change could not be saved. Try again in a few minutes.
pulses.startAsk: Start pulses now for all {members} members?
pulses.startAskBody: The first pulse opens now and stays open for {days} days. The next one opens {weeks} weeks later.
pulses.changeNote: The change applies to the pulses to come. A pulse that is open keeps its own dates.
pulses.stopAskBody: No new pulse opens. A pulse that is open runs to its close, and every result stays.
pulses.builtOrder: Built in this order: the focus areas' scales first, then one question per working agreement, then up to {rotating} rotating questions. At most {max}.
pulses.noFocus: No focus area is chosen yet, so the pulse has no focus questions.
pulses.waiting: {count, plural, one {# working agreement does not fit and rotates into a later pulse.} other {# working agreements do not fit and rotate into later pulses.}}
pulses.builtWhenOpens: A pulse is built when it opens, so this list can change before then.
pulses.missedBody: Fewer than {k} answered, so no result was made and the answers were deleted.
pulses.openBody: {answered} of {total} answered. The result opens when the pulse closes, if at least {k} have answered.
pulses.resultNotYet: The result opens when the pulse closes.
pulses.resultSummary: Opened {opened} · {answered} of {total} answered. Counts only, never names.
pulses.changeRule: Change compares each focus area and agreement with the last pulse that asked it. It shows at {margin} points or more.

settings.title: Settings
settings.accountMeta: How you sign in, and the time zone your summary follows.
settings.signInEmail: By email, with a link or with a password you set.
settings.timeZoneHint: When your summary arrives, and the dates in it.
settings.saveFailed: This could not be saved. Try again in a few minutes.
settings.sessionsHint: Signs you out on every device, this one included.
settings.signOutFailed: You could not be signed out everywhere. Try again in a few minutes.
settings.deleteBody: This removes you and everything that names you: your memberships, Leader Profile, actions, settings and sign-in.
settings.deleteKeeps: What you wrote for a group stays with the group, without your name. Group answers stay too: nothing links them to you.
settings.deleteAlone: A group where you are the only member is deleted with you.
settings.deleteAsk: Delete your account? This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteSoleLeader: You are the only team leader of {groups}. On the Group page, make another member team leader first.
settings.deleteFailed: Your account could not be deleted. Try again in a few minutes.
settings.groupMeta: Settings for {group}. Only the team leader can change them.
settings.groupReadOnly: Read only. Ask the team leader to change these.
settings.groupNameInvalid: Give the group a name of 1 to 120 characters.
settings.membersHint: {members} of {max}. Invite and remove them on the Group page.
settings.thresholdHint: Results show only at this many answers. {organisation} requires at least {threshold}. It can be raised, never lowered.
settings.thresholdScope: It holds for every group in {organisation}, from the next round each one opens.
settings.thresholdAsk: Raise the threshold to {n}? It can never be lowered again.
settings.thresholdNotHigher: The threshold is already this high or higher.
settings.thresholdTooFew: This group has {members} members, so at {n} its results would never show.
settings.notLeader: Only the team leader can change this.
settings.rhythmHint: The Full diagnostic and pulse setup live in Assess.
settings.notificationsMeta: What waits for you: questionnaires to answer, your open actions and the next meeting.
settings.summary_weeklyHint: Monday morning, in your time zone.
settings.summary_monthlyHint: The first Monday of the month, in the morning.
settings.summary_offHint: No summary. Invitations to answer still arrive.
settings.summaryNote: A summary goes only when something waits for you. It never says who has or has not answered.
settings.alwaysMeta: Each goes only to you, and names nobody else.
settings.alwaysInvite: An invitation when a questionnaire opens for you, with the link to answer.
settings.alwaysReminder: Reminders while it is open, only if you have not answered. A reminder never says who has not answered.
settings.alwaysExport: The link to your data, when you ask for it.
settings.consentsMeta: Your Leader Profile is yours. Change what each group sees, or delete it, at any time.
settings.profileTaken: {test}, taken {date}. Shared with {count, plural, =0 {no group} one {# group} other {# groups}}.
settings.profileFailed: Your Leader Profile could not be read. Try again in a few minutes.
settings.exportHint: Everything stored about you, as a file. A link arrives by email and works once, for 24 hours.
settings.exportSent: The link is on its way to {email}. It works once, for 24 hours.
settings.exportTooMany: You have asked for 5 exports today. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
settings.exportFailed: Your export could not be made. Try again in a few minutes.
settings.handledMeta: These rules hold for every group.
settings.handledAnonymityBody: Group results show only at the group’s threshold, never under 4 answers. No subgroup filters exist.
settings.handledNamesBody: Answers are stored without a person or a time. Counts only, never names.
settings.handledProfileBody: Your Leader Profile goes to you first. A group sees it only at the level you share.
settings.handledRetentionBody: After a cancel or an unpaid trial, Team data is kept {days} days, then deleted. A Free group with no sign-in for 12 months is deleted.
settings.handledWhereBody: All data is stored in the EU.
settings.handledPurposeBody: Development only. Never used for selection, promotion or performance evaluation.
settings.readFailed: Your settings could not be read. Try again in a few minutes.

exportFile.heading: Download your data
exportFile.lead: Everything {product} stores about you, as a ZIP with one JSON file and a note on what it holds.
exportFile.once: The link works once. After the download it no longer works.
exportFile.noAnswers: Your answers to the scan, the diagnostic and pulses are not in it: none is stored with your name.
exportFile.usedBody: Each link works once. Ask for a new export under Settings, Privacy.
exportFile.expiredBody: A link works for 24 hours. Ask for a new export under Settings, Privacy.
exportFile.unknownTitle: This link does not lead to an export
exportFile.unknownBody: Check that the whole link was copied, or ask for a new export under Settings, Privacy.
exportFile.failed: The export could not be read. Try again in a few minutes.
exportFile.readme1: Everything {product} stores about you, as it was on {date}.
exportFile.readme2: data.json holds your account, groups, Leader Profile, actions, and what you proposed, recorded or put in force.
exportFile.readme3: Your answers to the scan, the diagnostic and pulses are not in it: none is stored with your name.
exportFile.readme4: Another member’s words are left out. Invitations you sent are counted, not listed.

mail.roundBody: Your group has opened {what}. It closes on {date}.
mail.roundAnon: Answers are stored without your name. Your team leader sees how many have answered, never who.
mail.reminderBody: You have not answered {what} yet. It closes on {date}.
mail.reminderNote: This reminder goes only to you. Nobody sees who has or has not answered.
mail.inviteBodyPlain: You are invited to join {group} on {product}.
mail.inviteAbout: {product} helps a leadership team see how it works, then improve it meeting by meeting.
mail.exportBody: Here is the link to everything {product} stores about you. It works once, until {date}.
mail.exportNote: If you did not ask for this, you need do nothing: the link expires on its own.
mail.summaryLead: Here is what waits for you.
mail.summaryFooter: Change how often this arrives under Settings, Notifications.
mail.footer: You get this from {product} because this address belongs to a member of a group.
mail.footerInvite: You get this because a team leader entered this address on {product}.
